
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/formulahendry/p/19823017" title="发布于 2026-04-05 10:47">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">我开发的 ACP Client，被 LangChain 官方推荐了！轻松连上 Claude、Codex、Copilot、OpenClaw 等任意 Agent</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span>大家好！我是韩老师。</span></p>
<p><span>事情是这样的。</span></p>
<p><span>相信不少童鞋应该知道，我最近在搞一些有关 ACP 的内容：</span></p>
<p><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIwODE4Nzg2NQ==&amp;mid=2650564663&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=28cf9b6fe0c48d446a7d432870e177b6&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="8" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">2026年不懂ACP，相当于2025年不懂MCP&amp;Skills</a></span></p>
<p><span>平时呢，我其实用 VS Code 相对比较多。所以呢，两个月前，我也用业余时间，开发了个 VS Code 的 ACP Client extension：</span></p>
<p><span><a class="normal_text_link mp_article_text_link" href="https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s?__biz=MzIwODE4Nzg2NQ==&amp;mid=2650564498&amp;idx=1&amp;sn=5fa7ec56aef9c16fd6b8bb97fead26af&amp;scene=21#wechat_redirect" target="_blank" data-itemshowtype="0" data-linktype="2" rel="noopener nofollow">VS Code 的 ACP Client 扩展来啦！连上 Claude, Gemini, Codex, OpenCode, Qwen Code 等 AI Agent</a></span></p>
<p><span>如此一来，就可以在 VS Code 中轻松连上&nbsp;<span>GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Qwen Code, Codex CLI, OpenCode, OpenClaw 等数十种全球主流的 AI Agent 了！</span></span></p>
<p><span>代码也是完全开源的，传送门：</span></p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/formulahendry/vscode-acp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span>https://github.com/formulahendry/vscode-acp</span></a></p>
<span>就在这两天，我发现&nbsp;<span>ACP Client 的使用量也是越来越多了。</span></span><span>调研了一番，发现在&nbsp;<span>LangChain<span>&nbsp;的官网上，我的&nbsp;<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,null]">ACP Client 被推荐了：</span></span></span></span>
<blockquote>
<p><span>https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/deepagents/acp<a class="wx_topic_link" data-topic="1" data-recommend="">#clients</a></span></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1857417/202604/1857417-20260405104523492-1596643932.png" alt="image" width="520" height="682" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><span>已经成为 LangChain 官网推荐的四大 ACP Clients 之一！</span></p>
<p><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>其实，不知不觉中，我已经开发了三种不同的 ACP Client，可以适用于不同的用户群体！</span></p>
<p><span>如果你是 VS Code 用户，可以用&nbsp;<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,null]">ACP Client extension：</span></span></p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/formulahendry/vscode-acp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span><span>https://github.com/formulahendry/vscode-acp</span></span></a></p>
<p><span>如果你想要在 Windows/macOS/Linux 上有一个轻量级的 ACP Desktop 界面，可以用跨平台的 ACP UI：</span></p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/formulahendry/acp-ui" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span><span>https://github.com/formulahendry/acp-ui</span></span></a></p>
<p><span>如果你想要在手机微信（iOS 或者 Android）连上 Agent，可以用 WeChat ACP：</span></p>
<p><a href="https://github.com/formulahendry/wechat-acp" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow"><span><span>https://github.com/formulahendry/wechat-acp</span></span></a></p>
<p><span>总有一款适合你！</span></p>
<p><span>在任意地方任意时间，轻松连上任意 Agent~</span></p>

</div>
